name: Signal Board
prompt: High-fidelity north-star comp for XTab, composition C. Use the supplied DevStart screenshot as structural reference only; do not copy its brand, blue styling, exact grid, people, names, stats, or colored logos. Design a 1536x1024 landscape precision-monochrome new-tab workbench with a more editorial hierarchy. Structure: 72px header with XTab left and GitHub connect, theme, settings right; centered command area with wide search, shortcut hint, and five square quick-site buttons; lower 26/48/26 grid. Left has RSS with one strong first row and six compact rows, center starts with a large featured GitHub recommendation then a two-column set of six compact recommendation rows, right stacks signed-out GitHub, grayscale contribution matrix, and recent-activity empty state. Light theme strict palette #F5F5F5, #FFFFFF, #FAFAFA, #E8E8E8, #D6D6D6, #A3A3A3, #141414, #525252, #6B6B6B, #171717. Matte flat surfaces, crisp 1px dividers, 8-12px corners, near-zero shadow, restrained mono section indexes, black-white active states. No readable fake repo metrics, article claims, usernames, or dates; only XTab, Search, RSS, and GitHub clearly readable. No gradients, neon, glow, glass, hero copy, wallpaper, photos, colored icons, fake metrics, or watermark.
